title: Colts' fire sale continues as Indianapolis trades DT DeForest Buckner back to 49ers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Colts' fire sale continues as Indianapolis trades DT DeForest Buckner back to 49ers
sources.description: The Indianapolis Colts continued their fire sale, agreeing to trade three-time Pro Bowl defensive tackle DeForest Buckner to the San Francisco 49ers.
